lines.zh: 干枯的手指摸索着前进
我拖着断腿，在碎玻璃上挪。
lines.en: I drag my broken leg across the broken glass.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指在地面爬行
腐朽的声音在风中飘荡
我拖着一条腿，也在加速。
lines.en: Dragging one leg, I still pick up speed.

lines.zh: 第 44 号，跑起来最难看。
lines.en: Number 44, and the ugliest runner of all.

lines.zh: 腐烂的嘴巴发出嘶嘶声
腐烂的身躯无力地瘫坐
我跑起来时，膝盖会反着折。
lines.en: When I run, my knees bend backward.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家发出尖锐嘶叫
目光充满渴望盯着玩家
盯着玩家发出微弱的嘶声
盯着玩家发出轻微的嘶嘶声
被扔过来的东西打中了。
焦味从我的脊背冒起来。
lines.en: A burnt smell rises from my spine.

lines.zh: 腐肉的香味引诱着你靠近
lines.en: The smell of rotting flesh draws you near

lines.zh: 饥饿的阴影在你心中徘徊
腐烂的笑声在夜空中回荡
lines.en: The sound of rot echoes in the night

lines.zh: 你的眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒
lines.en: Greedy eyes glimmer in the dark

lines.zh: 你被腐烂的味道所诱惑
lines.en: You are tempted by the stench of decay

lines.zh: 腐尸的气息让你无法抗拒
你感受到了腐肉的美味
lines.en: You feel the taste of rotting meat

lines.zh: 它的存在是对你的诱惑

lines.en: The temptation of decay is strong

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的腐烂肢体
lines.en: You collide with its rotten limb

lines.zh: 它的身体阻挡了你的道路
碰撞中你感受到了它的疼痛
lines.en: You feel its pain in the collision

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉体摩擦着你的皮肤
lines.en: Decaying flesh rubs against your skin
You break through its rotting skin

lines.zh: 碰撞中你感受到了它的坚硬
lines.en: You feel its hardness in the collision

lines.zh: 它的腐烂肢体纠缠着你
碰撞中你感受到了它的湿滑
lines.en: You feel its slime in the collision

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉体碰撞让你害怕
lines.en: The collision of rotting flesh terrifies you

lines.zh: 你撞倒了它腐烂的身躯
lines.en: You knock over its rotting body
It searches for the scent of a mate
It searches for a mate in the dark
It searches for a mate in the horde

lines.zh: 腐尸渴望着生命的延续
lines.en: The runner yearns for the continuation of life
It yearns to mate with its kind
It searches for life in the rot

lines.zh: 腐尸渴望着繁衍的机会
lines.en: The runner craves the chance to reproduce

lines.zh: 它在尸群中寻找交配的对象
lines.en: It searches for a mate in the horde

lines.zh: 我的皮肤裂开了，露出血肉。
这里是我的领地，别靠近。
lines.en: This is my territory, stay away.

lines.zh: 这片废墟我先占的，滚开。
lines.en: I claimed these ruins first; get out.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在碰撞中发出响声。
lines.en: My bones rattle with each impact.

lines.zh: 我被咬了一口，无法愈合。
lines.en: I was bitten, and it won't heal.
I scavenge for strength in the flesh.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤让我更容易行走。
lines.en: Decaying skin makes me more agile.
I zero in on the living.
I'll make them scream in pain.

lines.zh: 我要成为这片土地的主宰。

lines.en: I run far faster than a walker.
You are bleeding; I smelled it.

lines.zh: 别回头，我会追上你的脚跟。
lines.en: Don't look back, I am right at your heels.

lines.zh: 整片群系里，我到处都在。
lines.en: Across this whole biome, I am everywhere.

lines.zh: 你一跑，我这两条腿就来劲。
lines.en: The moment you run, my legs wake up.

lines.zh: 我要享受撕裂他们的快感。
lines.en: I'll savor the tearing of their flesh.

lines.zh: 他们的恐惧是我的食物。
我要让他们在我脚下哀嚎。

lines.en: I'll turn them into one of us.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，但停不下来。
lines.en: My legs shake, but they will not stop.

lines.zh: 把手伸出来，我先咬手指。
lines.en: Reach out, and I bite your fingers first.
The moment you stop, I am there.

lines.zh: 断腿的痛，我也想让你尝尝。
lines.en: I want you to taste a broken leg too.
Circling will not help; I do not tire.

lines.zh: 我扑向你，是因为跑不动了。
lines.en: I lunge because I cannot run any longer.

lines.zh: 这具身体烂了，但还在跑。
lines.en: This body is rotting, but it still runs.

lines.zh: 你手腕裂开，血滴在我手上。
lines.en: Your wrist splits, and blood drips onto my hand.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里还卡着上个人的布。
lines.en: Cloth from the last one is still stuck in my teeth.
I barrel into you and pin you down!
I bite the side of your neck!
My nails slice your arm and blood runs!

lines.zh: 我把你拖在地上跑了一段！
lines.en: I drag you along the ground a while!
After this bite, you will run too!
I stand up, and the sky goes dark.

lines.zh: 我从废墟后面冲出来，没停过。
lines.en: I burst from behind the ruins, never slowing.

lines.zh: 路的尽头，一个影子在加速。
lines.en: At the road's end, a shadow accelerates.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很乱，但很近。
lines.en: My footsteps are ragged, but near.

lines.zh: 这号外观，生来就是为了追。
lines.en: This look was made for chasing.

lines.zh: 蓝火钻进骨头，冷得发疼。
lines.en: Blue fire seeps into my bones, cold and aching.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的手指全黑了。
lines.en: The bolt falls, and my fingers blacken.
